Setup pages keep a change only when you press Save, or Apply for colours

Every picture is the real platform, photographed, with the new parts drawn into the live page. The behaviour is HR-ERP's. Parts marked To check are new in this round. The rest you have already agreed.

1 · Colours: pick, and nothing changes until Apply Agreed

Only the colour box and its code change. Under the table are Apply, Discard, and 1 change not applied yet: the accent.

2 · Colours: after Apply, Undo for a few seconds Agreed

The page takes the new colour for everyone. Undo shows for about ten seconds and puts back the colours from just before. Reset to the shipped palette goes back to the platform's navy and gold.

3 · The same rule for every colour: Scoring bands To check

You pick a new colour for Needs attention. The pill on the right keeps today's colour until you press Apply, then Undo shows for a few seconds, as with the colours above. The bands table is one area, so a floor or a name changed in the same table is applied with it.

4 · Another Setup page with Save: Roles & access To check

You change Owner's own reporting from read-and-change to read only. The cell you changed is outlined, and under the table are Save, Discard, and 1 change not saved yet: Owner · their own reporting. Nobody's access changes until you press Save.

5 · Leaving without saving Agreed

You press another page on the left. A strip at the bottom asks: Save and continue, Discard changes or Keep editing. The same for the browser's Back button and Sign out.

6 · Terminology goes, and the shape screen names End in Mind To check

Client set-up › The shape, first section: a new row under Winning Aspiration, for the line under it. It has no tick because it is shown whenever the aspiration is. Words already typed on Terminology stay, so nothing on screen changes.

What you are agreeing to

Anything that sets a colour
Apply, Discard, and Undo for about ten seconds after Apply. Nothing on the page changes before Apply. The tenant's colours and Scoring bands today, and any colour control built later.
Every other Setup page where you change settings
Save and Discard under each area, with the amber line. For example Roles & access, Revenue drivers, Focus measures, Landing line and Figure sets. The plan and report pages keep saving on their own for now.
Tables with a pen on each row
Business units, Functions, the People register and the rest keep their row Save and Cancel, and get the leave question.
Pages that act when you press a button
Send an email, Import, and opening or closing the cycle stay as they are.
If a save fails
The reason shows in red beside Save or Apply, and your changes stay on the screen.
Terminology
The page leaves Setup. End in Mind is named on the shape screen with every other word.
